verdict.rationale: Firebase CLI documents import/export of Auth users (open JSON) and one user notes deliberately keeping Firestore as a plain JSON store for portability, but there is no documented open-format export path for Firestore, Storage, or Security Rules, and multiple community accounts explicitly describe painful lock-in ('keenly aware of the cost of lock-in', 'need to reimplement storage rules — an absolute pain', 'the lock-in effect is super bad') when trying to migrate away. Missing for 10: comprehensive documented export of Firestore/Storage/Rules in open formats, first-party migration tooling, and independent confirmation that leaving is frictionless.
